title: Instance backups
description: Create a consistent ZIP copy of the database and encryption keys without stopping the instance (full disaster recovery archive, distinct from executor runtime snapshots).
sensitive: Backups contain credentials, session tokens and encryption keys. The ZIP is not encrypted. Store it privately and keep an off-host copy.
created: Backup created. Download a copy for off-host storage.
createFailed: Backup failed or another backup is running. Refresh the list and check the server logs before retrying.
downloadFailed: Download failed. The backup may have expired; refresh the list and try again.
loadFailed: Could not load backups. Refresh to retry.
empty: No backups yet. Create one before upgrading or rotating keys.
retention: Keep the latest {{count}} archives after each successful, verified backup
dailyRetention: Also retain the newest archive each day for {{count}} days (UTC)
weeklyRetention: Also retain the newest archive each week for {{count}} weeks (UTC)
minimumLocal: Keep at least one local archive. Archives being created, verified or downloaded cannot be deleted. Active downloads postpone cleanup until the next successful backup.
deleteDescription: Permanently delete the local archive {{name}}. This cannot be undone. Downloaded copies and current runtime data are unchanged. Confirm you no longer need this recovery point.
deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Refresh the list and check storage permissions before retrying.

deleteErrors.last_local_backup: The last local archive cannot be deleted. Create another backup first.
deleteErrors.backup_busy: Backup creation, verification or management is in progress. Try again later.
deleteErrors.backup_in_use: This archive is being downloaded. Wait for the download to finish.
deleteErrors.backup_not_found: The archive no longer exists. Refresh the list.

onlineRestoreWarning: Tracker, executor, credential and history changes after this backup will be lost. The app briefly enters maintenance and reloads its services. Sign in again using an account from the backup. Remote business containers are not stopped or rolled back.
restorePreflight: Verifying the archive and database/key pair…
restoreSafetyExplanation: A current-state safety copy is saved before switching. Old tasks, approvals and notifications are revoked. Review actual remote state after restoration.
restoreNameConfirmation: Type the complete backup filename to confirm
restoreLossAcknowledgement: I accept restoring this time point and losing subsequent data changes.
restoreInProgress: Restoration is running. Please wait; do not submit it again.
restoreStatusUnavailable: Restore status is temporarily unavailable. Do not repeat the restore. Refresh the result or sign in to check.
restoreSucceeded: Restored and services reloaded. Sign in again, review actual remote state, then resume new operations.
restoreRolledBack: The original database/key pair was restored and services are available.
restoreBlocked: Maintenance remains active. An administrator must check logs before restarting the instance.
restoreReviewWarning: The instance was restored. Automatic jobs and notifications are paused. Review remote versions, executor configuration and pending targets. Confirmation enables new operations only; old tasks, approvals and notifications stay revoked.
restoreReviewConfirm: Remote state reviewed; resume new operations
restoreReviewed: Review confirmed. New operations and scheduling resumed.
restoreSafetyRetention: Separate from normal retention, it preserves the most recent pre-restore state until the next online restore. Download an off-host copy.
onlineRestoreExplanation: Local archives support page-initiated restore: preflight and a safety backup, brief maintenance, paired data/key switching, then service reload. Requires one data-directory owner. Old deployment approvals never resume. Cross-version or offline disaster recovery still uses the CLI below.

restorePhases.draining: Entering maintenance; draining requests and background work…
restorePhases.safety_backup: Saving and verifying the current-state safety copy…
restorePhases.closing: Closing old database connections and clients…
restorePhases.switching: Switching the database and paired keys…
restorePhases.rolling_back: Restoration failed; restoring the original pair…

restoreErrors.restore_busy: Backup or restoration is in progress. Try again later.
restoreErrors.restore_active_work: Tasks, downloads, readiness checks or native runtime operations are active. Wait for them to finish.
restoreErrors.restore_unresolved_deployment: A deployment/recovery is running or needs operator reconciliation. Resolve it before restoring the instance.
restoreErrors.restore_plan_expired: The restore plan expired or does not match. Revalidate before confirming.
restoreErrors.restore_archive_changed: The archive changed. Revalidate it; the old confirmation cannot be reused.
restoreErrors.restore_validation_failed: The archive is damaged, incompatible or cannot be decrypted. Choose a compatible trusted backup.
restoreErrors.restore_confirmation_required: Enter the complete filename and acknowledge data loss.
restoreErrors.restore_cleanup_failed: Old services could not fully close. No data was switched; maintenance remains active.
restoreErrors.restore_rollback_failed: Automatic rollback could not finish. Maintenance remains active; retain the data directory and investigate.
restoreErrors.restore_interrupted: Process exit interrupted restoration. Startup revoked the operation and restored the original pair when required.
restoreErrors.restore_failed: Restoration failed. Check the result and server logs; do not repeatedly submit.
restoreErrors.backup_not_found: The backup no longer exists. Refresh the list.

restoreDescription: Stop the instance first. Restore a trusted archive to a new directory with the matching application image, then switch the data mount. Existing data is never overwritten. Review pending deployments before restarting; restoring the database does not undo external updates.
configuration: Manage retention and the backup interval in System Settings → Global. Backups are automatically stored in backups under the data directory (container defaults to /app/backend/data/backups, development defaults to backend/data/backups); defaults: automatic backups disabled, 7 copies.
failing: The last {{count}} backup(s) failed: {{reason}}. Notifiers subscribed to the “error” event were alerted.
overdue: Automatic backups are overdue: the newest successful backup is older than two intervals.

errors.storage_error: Storage error (disk full or directory unavailable)
errors.too_large: Database exceeds the backup size limit
